description.value:
As a member of House Medani, your life revolves around subterfuge—not practicing it, but stopping others from doing so. You see the world as a tangled web of schemes, plots, and counterplots. Weighing every possibility, you trust your instincts to foresee threats to your clients and counter them long before they become dangers. Any Deneith sellsword or Tharashk enforcer can stop an assassin's blade; making sure no one ever draws that blade is the Medani way.

Ability Scores: Dexterity, Intelligence, Wisdom

Feat: @UUID[Compendium.compendium-owidyn.backgrounds-feats.Item.LsWDyaI243mchkXd]{Mark of Detection}

Skill Proficiencies: Insight and Investigation

Tool Proficiency: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulDisguiseKi]{Disguise Kit}

Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbtulDisguiseKi]{Disguise Kit}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagClothesFine]{Fine Clothes}, 10 GP; or (B) 50 GP

VnLoCHVPstGditGu.title: Background Ability Score Improvement
VnLoCHVPstGditGu.hint: Your background allows you to increase your Dexterity, Intelligence, and Wisdom scores; increase one of them by 2 and a different one by 1, or increase all three by 1. None of these increases can raise a score above 20.
